name: Gwetome Academy: A New Year
source:
Welcome to Gwetome Academy, where this story–your story–is continuing into its second year of high school. A new year of love, lust, and violent tendencies. What route will you choose? 

[From [url=https://dinodrummer.itch.io/gwetome-academy]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
欢迎来到格威托姆学园，这个故事——属于你的故事——即将在此迈入高二学年。崭新的一年里，交织着爱恋、情欲与暴力倾向。你将选择踏上哪一条路线？

[摘自[url=https://dinodrummer.itch.io/gwetome-academy]itch.io[/url]]
